ambiguity: At small sizes it looks almost identical to a circle with an X (close/clear button) or a generic delete icon.

reasoning: An octagon with an X universally signals stop, cancel, block, or critical error (and is the standard symbol for ad-blockers). While somewhat abstract and status-like, it fits action-driven tasks about cancelling subscriptions, blocking spam/ads, revoking access, or fixing fatal errors, though it blurs with a generic close/circle-X button at small sizes.
